findings.body:
Frontmatter `description` is **1280 characters**. Several skill hosts (Claude Code / skills.sh style registries) truncate or reject descriptions above **1024**, so the long capability list and trigger catalogue can be cut mid-sentence — agents then miss routing cues for `setup` / `open-pr`.

This line was already over the cap before the PR (~1275); the reframe adds a few more characters rather than compacting. Keep a short routing summary here and leave the full trigger catalogue under `## Activation` (the body is not length-capped).

Pinning the same tag guarantees a **shared base prompt** (and shared extension file under Flow B) — it does **not** guarantee bit-identical review output. The local pass runs on whatever model the coding agent uses; CI runs the Action's configured provider/model. Wording like "identical reviews" will set a false expectation the first time local and CI disagree on a borderline finding.

Suggest: "Pinning `@v1.4.2` on both surfaces guarantees the same base prompt (and the same extension file when Flow B wires `prompt-extension-file`)." The second commit already softened the intro bullet; this Version-parity sentence is still the stronger overclaim.

summary:
## Verdict

Solid narrative reframe of the parent skill — the opening now surfaces both audiences, the Surface column makes local vs CI obvious, and the new **Default flow** header correctly scopes Steps 0–5 to capability #1. Steps 0–5 are byte-identical to the pre-PR base (verified). No security surface changes (`allowed-tools` stays read-oriented + Bash for git; no fetch-and-pipe install guidance).

Two precision issues remain in the rewritten intro/parity area; both are docs-only.

| # | Severity | File | Summary |
|---|----------|------|---------|
| 1 | ⚠️ warning | `skills/ai-diff-reviewer/SKILL.md:3` | Frontmatter `description` is 1280 chars (hosts commonly cap at 1024) |
| 2 | ⚠️ warning | `skills/ai-diff-reviewer/SKILL.md:51` | "guarantees identical reviews" overclaims local↔CI parity |

### Notes

- **Already on `main`:** this change merged as #37 (`e5b8caa`). Current `main` (v2.5.1) keeps the Local & CI framing and has since grown a fifth capability (`apply-review`), IAR caveats, and a compacted ≤1024 description — so these two nits are largely historical unless someone re-lands the branch tip.
- **Install pin example** still cites `@v1.4.2` while frontmatter `version` is `1.6.2` (pre-existing; only relocated). Not raised as a new finding.
- **Vendored** `.agents/skills/ai-diff-reviewer/**` untouched — Rule #14 preserved.
- **Procedural integrity:** `git diff` from PR base through HEAD leaves everything from `## Step 0 — Trust boundary` onward unchanged.

**Recommendation:** comment-only (merge was appropriate; address the two wording/length nits in a follow-up if still open on an unreleased line).
